concerns.text: T002 fails to implement checksumming of the raw dataset upon download, violating Constitution Principle III: 'Datasets MUST be checksummed and the checksum recorded under data/'.
T004 omits the specific calculation of RMSE as a percentage of the observed range, which is a mandatory requirement of SC-002 ('RMSE is measured as a percentage of the observed range').

The implementation plan explicitly requires a 'Sparse GPR Fallback' (T057) if N > 500 or heteroscedasticity is detected. While tasks.md implements the detection (T007), it silently drops the fallback implementation task.
